_howto: Edit this file only to update the site. status is one of: baseline | null | running | pending | advance | fail. 'numbers' is a list of {label, value}. 'link' is a repo-relative path (joined with SITE_CONFIG.repo) or a full URL. Set 'eta' on a running generation to show it. Every number here must come from a filed results/prereg file.

generations.label: Version 31
generations.change: A different way to teach rooms: start from version 19, give it a short lesson in echoey rooms, then mix the old and new versions together

numbers.label: Mixes tried
numbers.value: 10, from a little of the new version to all of it

numbers.value: None (the closest missed by 0.00003 on a 0-to-1 scale)

generations.note: The short lesson in echoey rooms made speech with no echo a little clearer in one way and a little less clear in another. Our rule needs every measure to be at least as good as version 19, and even the gentlest mix missed by a hair, so by our rules there was nothing to test further.

generations.note: The closest yet. Asking the program to stay close to version 19 worked: speech with no echo stayed as clean, and every real recorded room got a little better. But the help in echoey rooms came out just under our bar, and the direction cues got slightly worse when the crowd was quieter, so by our rules it did not pass.
